title: Recap: Describing Homes with amely, ami and ahol

sections.title: Connecting descriptions of dwellings and rooms
sections.content: You know *aki* from A2 Unit 4, *ami* from A2 Unit 12 and *amely* from B1 Unit 10 and *ahol* from Unit 10. Use *amely* or *ami* for a thing and *ahol* for a place: *a lakás, amely a parkra néz*; *az erkély, ahol kávét iszunk*. They link a description to the home.

items.spanish: Keresünk egy olyan társasházi lakást, amely csendes udvarra néz.
items.english: We are looking for a condominium apartment that overlooks a quiet courtyard.

items.spanish: Van egy erkélyünk, ahol reggel kávét iszunk.
items.english: We have a balcony where we drink coffee in the morning.

items.spanish: A lakás, amit keresünk, csendes és világos.
items.english: The flat that we are looking for is quiet and bright.
